# ship-ui

Your interface to the `ui` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`ui.dependencies`](references/docs/ui.dependencies.mdoc) — Dependency surface: custom-element tags, handled events, controller path.
- [`ui.diagnostics`](references/docs/ui.diagnostics.mdoc) — All diagnostics (parse + semantic + lint) for a `.sui` file, collected.
- [`ui.hover`](references/docs/ui.hover.mdoc) — Hover info for the symbol under the cursor (kind, origin, controller decl).
- [`ui.packs`](references/docs/ui.packs.mdoc) — Query the available UI component packs (filterable by category, tag, prop, slot, event).
- [`ui.read`](references/docs/ui.read.mdoc) — Read a `.sui` source by relative path. Resolves through the bundle's sources/ tree, then CDN, then ship store.

- [`ui.enter_edit_mode`](references/docs/ui.enter_edit_mode.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` — 
- [`ui.exit_edit_mode`](references/docs/ui.exit_edit_mode.mdoc) `[C1_WORKSPACE]` —
